subject: DPA execution / eSign routing + SCCs & evidence checklist
body:
From: Sandra Lim <sandra.lim@finbridge.com>
To: priya_natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: legal@finbridge.com
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA + SCCs evidence for procurement

Hi Priya / Marissa,

Thanks for the call this morning. As part of procurement we need to get the DPA signed and a short packet of evidence for SCCs / DPIA confirmation before our legal team will route final PO. Attached is our standard security questionnaire and a short list of evidence items we expect:
- Signed DPA (DocuSign preferred)
- SOC 2 Type II cover sheet or summary (past 12 months)
- Subprocessor list and approval lane
- Confirmation of SCCs approach for EU data and DPIA status for customer-controlled profiling

Could you confirm who at Redwood will sign, and whether you can provide SOC2 summary + subprocessor list by EOD Thursday? We're aiming to have procurement lock next week.

Attachments: FinBridge_Security_Questionnaire.pdf

Thanks,
Sandra Lim
Senior Contracts Manager
FinBridge Capital

-----Original Message-----
On Tue, Apr 11, 2028 at 10:05 AM priya_natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
To: Sandra Lim <sandra.lim@finbridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, k.iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA + SCCs evidence for procurement

Hi Sandra — great to meet earlier. We're aligned to move quickly on this. Plan below:

1) Legal review + redlines (Karthik) — we'll return a clean DPA for DocuSign by EOD Thursday (11:59pm PT).
2) Evidence packet — Marissa / CS will bundle SOC2 summary, subprocessor list, and DPIA note; aiming to send Thursday morning.
3) Signature routing — we ask you to route DocuSign to Marissa Cole (Sales Lead) then Karthik Iyer (VP Legal) for final sign-off; Redwood will countersign.

I've created a shared Drive folder for the evidence: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cDDPA-FinBridge-evidence

If that timeline works we'll lock PO intake next week.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: k.iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: priya_natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA + SCCs evidence for procurement

Folks — attaching the internal redline. Key notes for FinBridge to expect:
- Retention: propose 180 days for customer-requested deletion backstop language + standard backup retention carve-outs.
- SCCs: we accept standard EU SCCs; will include subprocessors appendix and controls mapping.
- Liability: limited to contract value except where statute requires.
- DPIA: we can provide a DPIA summary for the specific profiling use-case; full DPIA is customer-owned but we'll provide our inputs.

I'll send Redline v2 by EOD. Please review the doc and confirm the signature order.

Attachment: Redwood_DPA_v2_KI_redlines.docx

-Karthik
VP Legal, Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sandra Lim <sandra.lim@finbridge.com>
Cc: priya_natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, k.iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, legal@finbridge.com
Date: Wed, 12 Apr 2028 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA + SCCs evidence for procurement

Sandra — looping back with a mutual action plan to keep procurement on schedule.

Miro: proposed timeline
- Thu 4/13 AM: Redwood sends redline DPA + evidence packet (SOC2 summary, subprocessor list, DPIA note) to FinBridge legal.
- Thu 4/13 PM: FinBridge returns counterparty redlines (if any).
- Fri 4/14: DocuSign envelope sent for signatures (Marissa -> Karthik -> FinBridge exec).
- Mon 4/17: PO issuance and onboarding kickoff.

We will include the SOC2-Type II summary and a CSV of our subprocessor list. If you need anything beyond the one-page SOC2 summary (e.g., full report under NDA) let us know and we can coordinate via your procurement.

Action items:
- Priya: confirm signers (done).
- Karthik: approve final redline (please confirm by 4/13 11am).
- Sandra / FinBridge: route counterparty redlines to this thread.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Sandra Lim <sandra.lim@finbridge.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: legal@finbridge.com
Date: Thu, 13 Apr 2028 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA + SCCs evidence for procurement

Thanks, Marissa. Attached are our counterparty comments — mostly clarifications around the SCCs appendix and one narrow liability request related to data residency. We do need the SOC2 summary and subprocessor CSV to validate controls.

Two asks:
1) Can Redwood provide the SOC2-Type II one-page summary and a controls mapping (high-level) by tomorrow morning?
2) Can you confirm that the DocuSign envelope will be routed first to Marissa Cole then to Karthik Iyer (cc: Redwood procurement) for signature?

Attachment: FinBridge_counterparty_comments.pdf

-Sandra

-----Original Message-----
From: priya_natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sandra Lim <sandra.lim@finbridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, k.iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, legal@finbridge.com, dse@docusign.net
Date: Fri, 14 Apr 2028 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA + SCCs evidence for procurement

Sandra — thanks for the quick turn. Confirming next steps and final routing below.

1) Evidence packet: attaching SOC2-TypeII_Summary.pdf and a CSV subprocessor list to the Drive folder (link above). If FinBridge needs the full SOC2 report we can make it available under NDA; for procurement we hope the summary will suffice.
2) DPIA: Redwood will provide a DPIA summary note specific to the customer use-case by Monday (4/17).
3) Redlines: Karthik and I reviewed FinBridge_counterparty_comments.pdf and accept the majority of clarifying edits. Our legal team made two small edits on retention and one appendix note; we believe these are acceptable to your counsel.
4) DocuSign routing: we will send the envelope with the following order: Marissa Cole (Signatory for Redwood commercial), Karthik Iyer (VP Legal sign), then FinBridge exec (Final signing). DocuSign notifications will come from dse@docusign.net.

DocuSign envelope (pending): https://www.docusign.net/envelope/ABC12345RDW-FINB
Drive evidence: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cDDPA-FinBridge-evidence

Please confirm if you need the full SOC2 under NDA or if the one-page summary + controls mapping is sufficient to close procurement. We'll queue the envelope for Friday EOD PT if we get your go-ahead.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
